reception.handoff.description: Hand this conversation over to another agent of this business, one of the agents listed in your instructions, when what the customer asks is theirs. Same chat and same number: the other agent answers right away with its own instructions and tools. Give a short summary so the customer is not asked again. If the result says it was not handed over, keep the conversation or hand it to a person.

summary.description: For the agent that takes it, in one or two sentences: what the customer wants and what they already told you, so they are not asked again.
summary.title: Summary

to_agent_id.description: The agent that takes the conversation: the id of one of the agents listed under «Derivar a otro agente» in your instructions. Any other agent is refused.
to_agent_id.title: To Agent Id
